question: Use only the bundled MPRINT snapshot revision 4bdee90dff3610816e86d0eed29b4c4d0fe76e89. This is a dataset audit, not a treatment or safety question. Find all fluoxetine Gold records selected by lactation plus PK, then identify the PMID with the largest number of distinct automated Silver study-type labels. Inspect all of its PK-summary rows, retaining only rows with study_context_matched=true to avoid counting workbook copies. Subtract the maternal reported mean post/pre-exposure percentage for serotonin from the infant whole-blood reported mean post/pre-exposure percentage. Use the stored percentage summaries, not ratios recalculated from mean concentrations. Return the percentage-point difference with exactly one decimal place and no unit.
